limits: This is source review and owner-test binding before the requested one-shot scoring run; it does not claim any real score result.
Original historical ingestion availability, broker completeness and midpoint production equivalence remain unproven, as disclosed in the label metadata and report.
OHLC envelopes cannot establish intrabar barrier order, executable extreme prices or broker fills.
Overlapping horizons and shared dates remain dependent; the descriptive unadjusted intervals are not used for model selection.
Expected immutable private capture paths and a trusted local workspace are assumed. This review did not claim an adversarial filesystem sandbox or directory-entry crash durability.
verified: Both methods are fixed empirical training quantiles, one on raw target values and one on target divided by past-60-return RMS scale. No validation refit, hyperparameter search or winner selection occurs.
The declared three-pair 60/20/20 cutoffs use the same full actual price-time range formula as the inspected MA comparison. The origin grid is every five UTC label minutes after 204 real warm rows.
Origins and exact 15/30/60-minute targets remain within a contiguous real M1 session. Training targets must be strictly before validation and validation targets strictly before test.
Past volatility uses only 60 preceding real returns through the completed origin. Zero or nonfinite support is withheld rather than floored or filled.
Both quantile methods fit and score the same label-valid, positive-scale rows. Label missingness, scale missingness and insufficient predeclared counts remain visible by partition.
Predeclared minimum support is checked for train/validation/test before fitting; this uses availability counts rather than validation/test outcome magnitudes for selecting weights.
Signed/absolute endpoint, close-path and OHLC-envelope labels remain distinct. Real bid/ask is required for cost-related labels; missing bid/ask never creates inferred costs or tradeability.
Opportunity probability is only the training prevalence of either side having a positive after-spread endpoint; it is not a fitted directional classifier or a profitable-trading claim.
PRE_SCORE_TRAINING_BASELINES is created exclusively, flushed and fsynced, then hashed after readback before the first validation/test quantile or prevalence scoring loop.
Actual retained source hashes, source read clocks, dependency versions and protocol identity are bound; source/capture identity is checked again before accepting the final report.

Pinball loss, median MAE, interval width/coverage and tail misses use paired rows. Date resampling is whole-UTC-date and descriptive, with a minimum ten dates and no across-pair pooling or independent-row claim.

The same final time period had already been inspected for MA work. Every result is explicitly retrospective development, not a fresh holdout, calibration proof, model promotion or prospective forecast.
